about: The Notes tutorial: added to Notes the first time it opens, and again on demand (right-click Notes → Notes tutorial, or `etude note tutorial`). Note ids are @keys and media are media:<file in ./media>, both filled in on import.

content.text: Notes turns Etude into a place to write, not only to review.
This folder shows everything it can do, one page per topic, and each page ends with a short tutorial you can follow with your own hands.

notes.title: fourier.py
notes.content:
"""Square wave from its Fourier series: the more odd harmonics, the sharper the corners."""
import numpy as np


def square(x: np.ndarray, terms: int) -> np.ndarray:
    total = np.zeros_like(x)
    for k in range(1, 2 * terms, 2):  # odd harmonics only
        total += np.sin(k * x) / k
    return 4 / np.pi * total


if __name__ == "__main__":
    x = np.linspace(0, 2 * np.pi, 9)
    for n in (1, 3, 25):
        print(n, np.round(square(x, n), 3))
